    How it works

    1. Design it above or just tell me what you want.
    2. WhatsApp me. One tap sends your design, pre-written.
    3. I sew it by hand and confirm your price and pick-up or delivery.
    4. Sleep like royalty. Wake up with hair that behaved overnight.

    Good to know

    Is it really handmade?

    Yes. Every bonnet is cut and sewn by me by hand, in Pretoria.

    What does reversible mean?

    Two colours, two looks. Wear whichever side you like on the outside.

    How long will my order take?

    I’ll confirm the timing with you on WhatsApp when you order, so you know before you pay.

    How do I pay, and how do I get it?

    Once I’ve confirmed your order, I’ll send payment details and arrange collection or delivery with you on WhatsApp.

    Can I bring my own fabric or add my name?

    Yes to both. I’ll quote you for the sewing or the name on WhatsApp.
